dogecoin.text: The company believes strongly in the potential of Dogecoin in payment systems, including platforms like X Money.

The company has already raised $15 million in its first round of financing.

Bit Origin aims to become one of the largest publicly traded DOGE holders, with a strategy to increase the value of Dogecoin per share.

Bit Origin Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin mining company, is planning to raise $500 million to buy Dogecoin for its corporate treasury. The money will be raised through the sale of $400 million in stock and $100 million in convertible debt.
